statements.text: I came to Congress to protect and strengthen Medicare. The Trump Administration’s effort under RFK to expand the use of costly and often-abused tools like AI-backed prior authorization in traditional Medicare is downright dangerous. https://t.co/uAllLvdta6

Last night was a good night for New Hampshire small businesses.

This is what commonsense governing looks like: lowering costs, cutting senseless red tape, and equipping hardworking Americans with the tools they need and deserve to meet the challenges and opportunities of the AI revolution.

America, not China, should lead the world in AI to ensure that AI works for American workers, American innovation, and America’s national security. 

Our bipartisan MATCH Act is about closing dangerous loopholes that China is exploiting, standing shoulder to shoulder with our allies on a level playing field, and winning the AI race against China.

https://t.co/oiueVLRIZm

AI has enormous potential—but only if small businesses can actually use it. In today’s Small Business Committee hearing, I pressed AI and tech experts on what it will take to help small businesses responsibly adopt this technology, compete fairly, and ensure the biggest players don’t get to dictate their future.
